title: calamagrostis neglecta subsp. groenlandica
intro: Calamagrostis neglecta subsp. groenlandica, commonly known as Greenland meadow-grass, is a sub-species of a type of grass. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of C. neglecta subsp. groenlandica may be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity. Research suggests that the bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
